QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] What Blundell Knows
QuestInfo.0: Hirrel the clerk talks about a top secret area kept concealed by the king. Meet General Blundell, the only person who's been there.
QuestInfo.1: You meet General Blundell to learn more about the secret area. He says that according to the princess, a girl called an 'omen of disaster' was transferred there.
QuestInfo.2: You met General Blundell. He said the someone wearing the same clothes as the researcher at the top secret area came here.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  54,171,275
Can proceed to [Kritias] What the Princess Knows

0.0: So, you're investigating His Majesty's disappearance. I'm ashamed to say that I, a general of Kritias, is focused on defense and can't check the well-being of His Majesty. But there is no country without its people. I think His Majesty would understand.\r\n#L0# #bI heard 'something' was transferred to the top secret area.#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, I took that there. The 'omen of disaster'.\r\n#L0# #bOmen of disaster?#l\n#k
0.2: A grandiose name, right? But it's just a girl. A survivor of the anti-magic accident in the Town Square.\r\n#L0# #bWho is the girl?#l\n#k
0.3: Well, I say 'girl,' but it just looks that way. It's not human. It's some terrifying being with unknown powers... That thing was taken to the lab below Kritias bound in chains. His Majesty strictly ordered all the soldiers there that day not to speak of it.\r\n#L0# #bSomeone else was there that day, right?#l\n#k
0.4: His Majesty's researchers... I don't know all the details, unfortunately. It seems many researchers who entered that top secret area have never been seen again, though.

yes.0: I'm hesitant to say more, but I saw that there was someone among the refugees in the top secret area. And it was the princess who vouched for that person's identity.
yes.1: Princess Ione would be able to tell you more. About His Majesty, the top secret area, and what happened that day.
yes.2: To be honest, I'm afraid to know the truth of what's become of His Majesty.

default.0: The princess is at the inn. Go see her.
